To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the gaming community is a highly engaged and interactive group of consumers.
the gaming industry has been successful in attracting the male market segment by creating brand engagement among them.

the male gaming enthusiasts are attracted to brands that are masculine in nature, that create a sense of anxiety, curiosity and excitement among them, that motivates them to play and that show them challenges and goals in life.
In summary, our research is concerned with
understanding how brand engagement is created and how the concept of brand engagement is different from other concepts such as brand loyalty and brand relationship.
how brand engagement is conceptualized in the context of the male market segment.
the question of whether the concept of brand engagement can be applied to video gaming.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
, brand engagement is the process that creates a strong and long lasting relationship between the consumers and the brand.
brand engagement is an emotional attachment to the brand that creates a sense of belonging and ownership.
the male gamers have a strong sense of brand engagement and the brand managers need to understand the factors that motivates and attracts them to create a brand engagement with the brands.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the study was able to identify how male gamers associate with video gaming and the brand engagement they have with the gaming brands.
the brand engagement is not a new concept but the way to achieve brand engagement is new and emerging.
brand engagement is an emerging concept that is not fully understood by marketers.
The main takeaway from our work is that
brands can be engaged with consumers through a variety of different ways and that brand engagement is not a one size fits all concept.
the gaming industry is an important industry that can be used to create a brand engagement with consumers.
brand engagement is a multidimensional phenomenon.
